  基础选择
>>> df3.loc[:,(df3>1).any()]
>>> df3.loc[:,(df3>1).all()]

数据分组
>>> df2.groupby(by=['Date','Type']).mean()
>>> df4.groupby(level=0).sum()
>>> df4.groupby(level=0).agg({'a':lambda x:sum(x)/len(x),
'b': np.sum})
转换
>>> customSum = lambda x: (x+x%2)
>>> df4.groupby(level=0).transform(customSum)
